skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 80% ATK(+10) DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 33% ATK(+3) DMG to the entire row with a 3-hit combo. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Corruption] on the main target for 2 turns (DMG reduction rate lowered by 30%).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 40% ATK(+3) DMG to the entire row with a 3-hit combo. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Corruption] on the main target for 2 turns (DMG reduction rate lowered by 30%).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). If a Deep Sea Invader is present, increases own DMG by 20% until the end of battle.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). If a Deep Sea Invader is present, increases own DMG by 25% until the end of battle.
